info.name: Coredeux DRL Spring Boot Demo API
info.description: Postman collection for the Coredeux DRL Spring Boot demo. The demo is database-backed: Java-like rule source is converted through DevTools and the generated DRL is stored in PostgreSQL. The convert endpoint accepts raw Java source text and stores the generated DRL as a rule record.

body.raw:
coredeux:
  entities:
    - full-class-name: com.coredeux.demo.domain.Customer
      name: customer
      identifier: pk
      storage:
        data-access-service: customerDataAccess.drl
      modules:
        - name: validators
          enabled: true
          handlers:
            - customerEmailValidator
            - customerValidator.drl
        - name: hooks
          enabled: true
          handlers:
            - demoLifecycleHook
            - customerHook.drl
        - name: audit
          enabled: true
          handlers:
            - demoAuditHandler
            - customerAudit.drl
          config:
            operations:
              - SAVE
              - UPDATE
              - DELETE
